timing_boundaries.Python: Fresh interpreter for each case/route/round; one fixed unmeasured warmup, checked and disposed before clocks; fixed measured calls; setup/checks/disposal excluded; no discarded measured samples or retries
timing_boundaries.FORM: Independent expression batch body CPU; startup/input/checks/export/disposal excluded. Copy count frozen after preserved calibration; final affinityCPU8. Wall records have wider process scope.

limitations: Three rounds are descriptive M0 observations, not a confidence interval or isolated R1/R2 causal estimate.

Initial FORM references inherited unrestricted launcher affinity. They are retained below but are not used for final ratios; all final references are a separate CPU8-only cohort with byte-identical exports and matching counts.

Initial free4-trace4 FORM copies=200 returned2ms then0ms and stopped the cohort. Neither sample is removed. The separate pinned reference calibrates the copy count to>=200ms before three fixed rounds; no completed Python sample was repeated.

Some strict4D/axial FORM and D-to-4 expressions differ in Schouten/epsilon basis. The false literal-equality flags remain; the accompanying three finite exact HEP checks are not general polynomial identity proofs.
The production numerator has exact cross-release and repeated-stage checks, not an independently authored FORM oracle.
Phase clocks are separate executions; pure Symbolica and FORM references have their documented complete-route/body scopes and are not paired release comparisons.
Canonical4e was unchanged; the M0 baseline is the qualified cfe4 release. All cooperating measurement work was serialized; external shared-host activity is uncontrolled.
Validation and factor-polynomial timing diagnostics were deferred when the parent released the build window. Commands remain available; no prototype speed claim is made.
